title: Defaults, counters and read-only tables
description:
Write three functions with `__index` and `__newindex`:

```lua-norun
with_defaults(t, defaults)   -- gives t a metatable so that a key missing from t is read from defaults; returns t.
                             -- Writing to t still writes to t, never to defaults.
default_table(value)         -- a new empty table where reading any missing key gives value (nothing is stored by reading)
read_only(t)                 -- a proxy: reading works like t (also #), but assigning any key raises the error
                             -- "attempt to change a read-only table"
```

```lua-norun
local counts = default_table(0)
counts.apples = counts.apples + 1     --> counts.apples is 1; counts.pears is still 0
```
hints: `__index` can be a table (look the key up there) or a function `function(t, key) ... end` whose result is used.
A proxy is an empty table, so `__newindex` runs for every assignment to it, and `__index` sends every read on to the real table.
unitTests:
test("defaults fill in missing keys", function()
    local defaults = { colour = "grey", size = 10 }
    local button = with_defaults({ colour = "red" }, defaults)
    check_eq(button.colour, "red")
    check_eq(button.size, 10)
    check_eq(button.missing, nil)
    button.size = 14
    check_eq(button.size, 14)
    check_eq(defaults.size, 10, "writing must not change the defaults")
    check_eq(rawget(button, "colour"), "red")
end)

test("default tables for counting", function()
    local counts = default_table(0)
    for _, fruit in ipairs({ "apple", "pear", "apple" }) do
        counts[fruit] = counts[fruit] + 1
    end
    check_eq(counts.apple, 2)
    check_eq(counts.pear, 1)
    check_eq(counts.plum, 0)
    check_eq(rawget(counts, "plum"), nil, "reading must not store anything")
    check_eq(default_table("?").anything, "?")
end)

test("read-only tables can be read", function()
    local days = read_only({ "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", first = "Mon" })
    check_eq(days[2], "Tue")
    check_eq(days.first, "Mon")
    check_eq(#days, 3)
end)

test("read-only tables refuse writes", function()
    local days = read_only({ "Mon" })
    check_error_like("read-only", function() days[1] = "Sun" end)
    check_error_like("read-only", function() days.new = true end)
    check_eq(days[1], "Mon")
end)
